calculateCorrespondingAdjustmentDesc: Per Decision 2/CMA.3 Chapter III — Application of corresponding adjustments

stillNeedCorrespondingAdjust: tCO2e of first-transferred ITMOs still need a corresponding adjustment recorded.

fullyReconciled: Fully reconciled — every first-transferred ITMO (net of acquired) has a recorded corresponding adjustment.
submitConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to submit this corresponding adjustment?
finalizeConfirmTitle: Finalize this NDC period? Every Draft year will be submitted together.
noNdcTargetForYear: No NDC target covers this year.
calculationComplete: Calculation complete — review, then save or submit
reportingYearTooltip: The country's actual emissions for this year. The adjusted balance is this figure plus the corresponding adjustment.
ndcTypeDerivedHint: Derived from the NDC period covering this year.
caMethodDerivedHint: Derived from the initial report this NDC target was filed from.
caMethodOverrideHint: This NDC target was migrated in without a source report — pick the method it was filed under.
noNdcTargetDescription: Submit an initial report for the NDC period containing this year, then return here.
alreadyFiledDescription: Showing the recorded calculation below — a filed year can no longer be recalculated.
periodTableFootnotePrefix: Each year's corresponding adjustment is the figure recorded for that year.
periodTableFootnoteTrajectory: Under Trajectory it is that year's own net first-transfer balance.
periodTableFootnoteAveraging: Under Averaging it is the running average across the period so far (cumulative adjustment ÷ elapsed years), so it moves as later activity lands.
submitBlockedYear: Reporting year {{year}} is not over yet — submit from 1 January {{nextYear}}.
submitBlockedPeriod: Under Averaging the whole NDC period is finalized together, from 1 January {{nextYear}}.
averagingBannerTitle: This year stays in Draft until the NDC period ends
averagingBannerDescription: Under the Averaging method every year's adjustment is a running average that can still shift as later activity lands, so no year is final on its own — the whole period is finalized together.
